applies_to: SPX Cooling / Marley MarleyGard CD cooling-tower water treatment controllers, software JA.12.1 and higher.
summary: The MarleyGard CD is a cooling-tower water treatment controller. It is a BACnet IP device that reports conductivity, pH, ORP, temperatures, water and flow meter totals, flow rates and 4-20 mA inputs for up to four systems, the setpoints and alarm limits, relay states and a large set of alarm flags. Every object in this list is read-only.
notes: Object names are generic (BI-000, BV-011, AI-008 ...); what each object means is in the Purpose column, shown here as the description.

The setup screen shows an advantagecontrols.com server and the WebAdvantage service, and most object numbers and purposes match Advantage Controls' MegaTron BACnet H22 list, so it looks like a MarleyGard-branded MegaTron (the manual does not say so). This older edition lists fewer objects and marks every one read-only.
The published PDF repeats page 8 as page 9 and does not print BV 93-133; those objects are not listed here.
No engineering units or relay state texts are given; values follow the units configured in the controller.
Most points repeat for System #1 to #4 whether or not those systems are installed.

integration.summary: Treat the MarleyGard CD as a monitoring device: read the chemistry inputs (conductivity, pH, ORP) and the flow switch for each system in use, and map the per-system All Alarms flags (BV 11, 80, 149, 218) as summary alarms.
setup: BACnet IP only (Annex J), on the same Ethernet port used for the WebAdvantage service.
Set the device instance in Configure > Network settings > BAC (some versions show DEV); 4194303 means unconfigured. The UDP port (47808) is set on the same screen.
The BMS must be on the same subnet as the controller, or routing must be set up for BACnet traffic.
gotchas: All objects are read-only in this edition; setpoints and limits cannot be changed from the BMS.
ReadProperty only: no ReadPropertyMultiple or COV, so poll at a modest rate.
BV 93-133 are missing from the published list.
